title: JSON String Escape
description: Escape plain text into a JSON string or unescape a JSON string back to text. Quotes, newlines and Unicode are handled locally with JSON.parse.
intro: Use this when a log, prompt or config needs a JSON-safe string. Escape wraps the text in quotes and escapes special characters. Unescape expects a JSON string literal.
blurb: Escape text for JSON or unescape a JSON string literal in the browser.
howItWorks: Escape uses JSON.stringify so quotes, backslashes and newlines become JSON escapes.
Unescape runs JSON.parse and requires a quoted JSON string, not a full object.
The conversion stays in the page; the input is not sent anywhere.
examples: Hello "world" escapes to a quoted string with a backslash before the quote.
A newline becomes the two-character escape \n inside the JSON string.

faq.q: Can I paste a whole JSON object?
faq.a: Unescape expects one JSON string literal. For objects, use the JSON formatter instead.
Yes. The output is a valid JSON string token, including the wrapping quotes.
